claim_cards.caveat: Visibility, not leads or sales; work-date matching, authorship, and client permission remain required.
claim_cards.claim: Google Search recorded 1,922 clicks and 68,908 impressions for taquerialapazchicago.com from 28 Aug 2025 through 27 Aug 2026.
claim_cards.evidence: GSC HTTPS property; exact 365-day slice from daily API data.

claim_cards.caveat: Partial current-property window; older property is not included. Confirm migration boundary and permission.
claim_cards.claim: The current GA4 property recorded 1,124 sessions from April through August 2026; 673 sessions (59.9%) were attributed to Organic Search.
claim_cards.evidence: Property 530891840; five reported months; created 1 Apr 2026.

claim_cards.caveat: Public/domain availability is not a Nice Right start date or authorship proof.
claim_cards.claim: The domain was registered 9 Feb 2024; the earliest returned Wayback homepage capture is 27 Apr 2024; 10 deduplicated HTML captures run through 15 Feb 2026.
claim_cards.evidence: RDAP and Wayback CDX/root capture inventory.

claim_cards.caveat: Events are tracking signals, not qualified leads or booked calls; no CRM join is connected.
claim_cards.claim: Nice Right’s current GA4 property recorded 259 sessions, 233 users, 17 form_start events, and 17 cta_click events from March through August 2026.

claim_cards.caveat: Low-volume branded visibility; not a growth or client-result claim.
claim_cards.claim: Search Console recorded 12 clicks and 619 impressions for sc-domain:niceright.co from 15 Apr 2025 through 27 Aug 2026; “nice right” generated 7 clicks.
claim_cards.evidence: Domain-level GSC property; 157 daily rows and 3 query rows.

claim_cards.caveat: Public presence is not proof of ownership, authorship, or SEO success.
claim_cards.claim: The UXOXO domain has an RDAP registration lower bound of 9 Nov 2023; Wayback’s earliest returned homepage capture is 9 Jan 2024; 12 deduplicated HTML captures run through 4 Mar 2025.

claim_cards.caveat: The split may be migration or duplicate instrumentation; GSC returned zero clicks.
claim_cards.claim: Two separate GA4 properties exist: 42 sessions across Apr–Jul 2024 and 756 sessions across Oct 2024–Aug 2026.
claim_cards.evidence: Properties 436318262 and 462480631 have separate creation dates and streams.

claim_cards.caveat: A live current page is not evidence of traffic or product-market outcome.
claim_cards.claim: Dummy Reader’s domain registration lower bound is 10 Dec 2025 and its GA4 property was created 25 Mar 2026, but the historical report returned zero data rows.
claim_cards.evidence: RDAP, GA4 Admin/Data API, and zero Wayback CDX captures.

claim_cards.caveat: The subtraction is a data-quality adjustment, not proof that every excluded session was automated or invalid. The campaign operator is unknown. GSC matched months do not show a comparable large search lift, and Nice Right causality remains unproven.
claim_cards.claim: After excluding the 574-session Sailthru / email attribution spike, the same legacy GA4 property still shows a descriptive 233.3% year-over-year session lift: 1,250 in Apr 2024–Mar 2025 to 4,166 in Apr 2025–Mar 2026.
claim_cards.evidence: Equal-length, same-property comparison; raw post total 4,740 less the mutually exclusive 574-session Sailthru / email row.
claim_cards.recommended_use: Internal hypothesis only until the intervention window and traffic quality are confirmed.

claim_cards.caveat: This is descriptive year-over-year movement, not causal lift; no pre-April-2025 GSC history is available.
claim_cards.claim: In matched Apr–Jun months, GSC clicks moved from 384 to 390 (+1.6%) year over year; impressions rose 6.7% while CTR fell 4.8% relatively.
claim_cards.evidence: Same calendar months, same HTTPS GSC property.
claim_cards.recommended_use: Use to prevent overclaiming a large search lift.

claim_cards.caveat: Short current-property window with no seasonality control; higher organic share does not mean more total demand.
claim_cards.claim: Within the current GA4 property, Organic Search share rose from 49.6% in Apr–May 2026 to 73.7% in Jul–Aug 2026 (+24.1 percentage points), while average monthly sessions fell 30.9%.

claim_cards.caveat: August contributes 80.4% of post-period sessions and Organic Search share falls 7.7 percentage points; no control or business-outcome join exists.
claim_cards.claim: Nice Right’s average monthly sessions rose 198.5% from the first three reported months (65 total) to the last three (194 total); the median-month lift is 121.4%.

claim_cards.caveat: The campaign operator is unknown. This does not prove the restaurant ran a newsletter, and the traffic quality is poor: 5.4 seconds average duration, 1.005 page views/session, 98.6% bounce rate.
claim_cards.claim: The October 2025 spike was tagged Sailthru / email under campaign 20251022_Newsletter_Chicago: 574 sessions arrived on 22-28 October, but only 8 engaged.
claim_cards.evidence: Raw GA4 source/medium, campaign, date, and engagement reports.
claim_cards.recommended_use: Exclude from case-study lift claims until the campaign is identified.

claim_cards.caveat: This is a source-level traffic signal, not proof of Nice Right authorship, leads, or revenue. Its exact date span follows the property data, April 2024 through April 2026.
claim_cards.claim: Across the available legacy GA4 period, Google / organic produced 2,829 sessions and 1,139 engaged sessions, with a 40.3% engagement rate and 107-second average session duration.
claim_cards.evidence: Aggregate GA4 source/medium report for property 436955005.
claim_cards.recommended_use: Better supporting evidence than the Sailthru spike; still needs work-date matching.

claim_cards.caveat: These are outbound click events, not completed directions, visits, calls, or orders.
claim_cards.claim: The legacy GA4 property recorded 80 outbound Google Maps click events from 73 users, including 69 engaged sessions. It also recorded 29 Instagram and 19 Facebook click events.
claim_cards.evidence: GA4 click event report grouped by link URL.
claim_cards.recommended_use: Local-intent support in a case study, after client permission.

claim_cards.caveat: GA4 records referring domains, not article URLs or who secured the mentions. Verify the pages before calling this press coverage or earned media.
claim_cards.claim: Named referral domains sent 159 sessions and 70 engaged sessions in the available legacy GA4 period: WTTW 81/35, WBEZ 43/23, Chicago Sun-Times 23/4, and City Cast 12/8.
claim_cards.recommended_use: Promising lead for a separate referral/source investigation.

claim_cards.caveat: A zero event row does not prove that no calls, orders, or leads happened. It proves only that these configured GA4 events were not observed in the queried properties and window.
claim_cards.claim: The GA4 properties have conversion-style key events configured, but the report returned no observed purchase, close_convert_lead, or qualify_lead events.
claim_cards.evidence: GA4 Admin key-event configuration plus event/key-event report for legacy property 436955005 and current property 530891840.

nice_right.comparison: First three reported months vs last three reported months

taqueria_current.comparison: First two reported months vs last two reported months of current property

taqueria_legacy.comparison: Same-property matched 12-month period: Apr 2024–Mar 2025 vs Apr 2025–Mar 2026

quality_adjusted_sessions.adjustment_note: Subtracts the mutually exclusive Sailthru / email source row from the post period. This is a data-quality adjustment, not proof that every excluded session was automated or invalid.

definition.causal_lift: incremental change attributable to an intervention; not estimable from these connected properties without intervention dates and a control/comparison series
definition.rate_lift_pp: post rate minus baseline rate, in percentage points

interpretation: Nice Right has a descriptive session lift (+198.5% in three-month average; +121.4% by monthly median), but August contributes 80.4% of post-period sessions and Organic Search share falls 7.7 percentage points. Treat it as a traffic pulse, not causal lift.

Taqueria legacy GA4 shows a raw +279.2% same-property year-over-year session change. After excluding the 574-session Sailthru / email row, the descriptive change is still +233.3% (1,250 to 4,166). The campaign operator is unknown, its traffic quality is poor, and neither number is causal lift.
Taqueria GSC matched Apr-Jun clicks are nearly flat (+1.6%) and matched Apr-Aug clicks are down 3.3%; the search data does not support a large year-over-year lift in the available comparable months.

Taqueria current-property GA4 shifts toward Organic Search (+24.1 percentage points in share) while equal two-month session averages fall 30.9%; mix improvement and volume lift are not the same thing.

not_estimable.Dummy Reader: No GA4 rows means no baseline/post comparison.
not_estimable.Nice Right_business_outcome: GA4 form_start/cta_click events are not joined to booked calls, leads, or revenue.
not_estimable.UXOXO: Two GA4 properties are separated by a measurement split; a single lift would falsely assume continuity.
not_estimable.difference_in_differences: No untreated control site or randomized exposure series is connected.

limitations: GA4 history begins at the API-valid reporting floor but is bounded by each property’s creation and first-data dates.
Search Console performance starts at the retained window; pre-April-2025 probes test retention, not absence of earlier traffic.
GA4 properties with overlapping project names are preserved separately; no migration properties were summed.
Wayback CDX is queried as an inventory; replay fetches are deferred when the service rate-limits this IP.
RDAP dates are registration lower bounds, not work-start dates.
Empty archive results do not prove a domain never existed.
Wayback direct replay was rate-limited from this machine; historical screenshots were obtained through image.thum.io pointed at exact Wayback URLs.
Current screenshots were captured through the user’s Brave session over CDP; no Orca Browser was used.
No claim establishes Nice Right authorship without project records and permission.
Lift calculations are descriptive comparisons; causal/incremental lift requires an intervention date and control/comparison series.
GA4 default-channel labels do not establish campaign ownership. Source/medium, campaign, quality, and operator must be checked separately.
